instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot at eye level. In a bright, minimalist office with a digital screen on the right, a group of colleagues performs a hand-stack. The man in the white button-down shirt (R5) stands on the far left in profile, extending his hands. Next to him, the man in the blue denim shirt (R2) also faces right, smiling. In the center, the laughing man in the black beanie and round glasses (R1) joins his hands to the stack. On the right, the smiling woman in the brown checkered blazer (R3) faces left, completing the circle. All four stack their hands together in the center in a collaborative gesture. The scene is illuminated by bright, even indoor light with soft shadows and a clean, neutral color palette.
elements: R3 completes the hand-stack circle from the opposite side of the group
R1 joins his hands into the shared central hand-stack
R5 extends his hands into the central stack while R3 completes the circle
R2 faces toward the shared hand-stack while participating with R1, R3, and R5
all referenced participants place their hands together in the center
a digital screen is visible in the bright minimalist office
